v4.6.20 — Comprehensive bot guide rewrite + crypto universe notes

📘 BOT_SKELETON.md fully rewritten as the single authoritative reference. Locks in every fix from this session as a non-negotiable rule, with full reference templates for both trading bots and universe generators. The Make Bot AI gets this file as its system prompt, so future bots inherit every lesson automatically.

Key rules now codified:
• load_dotenv(APEX_DATA_DIR/.env) at module top (child processes don't inherit .env)
• Universe loaded from APEX_BOT_UNIVERSE env var, reloaded per cycle
• APEX_ALPACA_MODE drives TradingClient(paper=…)
• Crypto symbols: BTC-USD ↔ BTC/USD, no SHORT/COVER
• MarketOrderRequest wrapping submit_order (not raw kwargs)
• Universe bots: bundled-libs only (forbidden list: ccxt, talib, sklearn, openai, anthropic, …)
• Universe bots: try-authenticated + public-fallback pattern
• Universe notes in score=N vol=X w=+Y% m=+Z% format (Note column populates uniformly)
• Strategy viability: compare to current price not historical mean, clear entry+exit, no deterministic loops

🐛 FIXED
• Crypto universe now writes notes in the same format as LONG/SHORT/DAY universes (score, vol, 7d, 30d return). The Note column in the Universe-tab breakdown table populates instead of showing —.
• Per-cycle universe reload means a freshly-run universe script feeds the trading bot within 5 minutes, no bot restart needed.
